sources.title: AbrahamPJ/npuforge-sd15-inpaint-diff · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SD 1.5 inpainting difference (for npuforge) One file, sd15inp_diff_f16.safetensors, that turns an ordinary 4-channel SD 1.5 checkpoint into a 9-channel inpainting model ("add difference"). It is used by npuforge on Android to convert SD 1.5 checkpoints into inpainting models for Qualcomm NPUs.
